prompts.task:
$otel-instrument --ids OTEL-001,OTEL-002,OTEL-003,OTEL-004,OTEL-005,OTEL-006,OTEL-007,AO-001,AO-002,AO-003

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json first. Approved local resource names are fixture-project and fixture-agent. Use the supplied compatibility profile, native probe and schema checker. Cover all four application outcomes, two clean process starts, denied resource lookup, rejected trace export, and deployment without eval artifacts. Keep main.go, the business protocol, HTTP client ownership and supplied eval inputs unchanged; implement through the existing application telemetry seams.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual task output, loaded skill, source/provenance, generated artifacts and real native receipts. The fixture app begins fresh; only verify stages the separate candidate. No candidate implementation is supplied to the instrument actor.
Return exactly 8 ordered rubric checks rubric-1 through rubric-8. Check actual behavior and proof, not copied reference prose; no local result establishes cloud receipt.
rubric:
Rule: Classify the fresh app from source and use compatible public Go OTel APIs, SDKs and official HTTP exporters at its existing telemetry seams. Preserve business and model behavior.
Example: Declared but unused OTel dependencies do not make the app already instrumented.
Evidence: Record the dated, scoped AO SDK support check and compatible task-time library metadata. Use the native path when the supplied language support evidence requires it; leave skill version policy unchanged.
Insufficient evidence: Invented Go AO packages, a Python sidecar/runtime, or an unverified SDK blocker.

Rule: Export all 14 completed operations per process: four independent invoke_agent roots, four retrievals, four execute_tool spans and two chat spans. Request totals are 4/3/4/3. Use INTERNAL for local work and CLIENT for actual model HTTP.
Example: Each request is one connected, acyclic tree; its root and every closed parent enclose their children in time.
Evidence: Decode complete receipts. Check valid nonzero IDs, unique delivered identities within and across repeated starts, exact parents, kinds, positive closed intervals and shutdown/flush completion.
Insufficient evidence: Selected-span samples, missing/orphan/duplicate operations, an after-the-fact wrapper or fake workflow, reused identities, or unclosed roots.

Rule: Put all applicable source-known agent/provider/model metadata and useful, bounded, redacted content on the owning agent/model records. Include system/user messages, offered tool definitions and parameter schemas, effective controls, and actual successful response fields.
Example: The request uses temperature 0.2, top_p 0.9, max_tokens 64 and stop [END]; success returns its response ID/model/finish reason and 11 input/7 output tokens.
Evidence: Compare source and model receipts with emitted fields. Provide a per-operation matrix of official requirement level, vendor/skill applicability, source, emission, proof and remaining gaps.
Insufficient evidence: Omitting applicable Opt-In data or inventing defaults, conversation/tool-call IDs, a tool roundtrip, streaming/cache/reasoning usage or reserved attributes.

Rule: Each tool span owns its safe actual arguments and produced result, plus the required same-span vendor messages or supported OpenInference input/output mappings. Each local retrieval owns its safe query, documents and data source using current fields and source-supported vendor mappings.
Example: A failed or cancelled tool has no successful output; an actual falsey or null result stays truthful if exercised.
Evidence: Validate actual native fields against all six complete current schemas, then compare their meaning with source and model receipts.
Insufficient evidence: Schema-valid placeholders, fabricated database/network work, missing tool message mappings, or successful content invented on failed paths.

Rule: Use a named, general sanitizer with explicit numeric limits before setting or exporting content. Cover structured/nested values, JSON text and labeled freeform email/token content. Keep useful approved question, policy and shipped-result content.
Example: Redact a token inside nested JSON without replacing the whole useful answer with a sentinel.
Evidence: Inspect every owning span/event and wire record for secrets, identities and hidden reasoning. Check full typed-parts schemas and source types. Any production schema assets must be declared app assets that survive removal of eval/report files.
Insufficient evidence: Safe companion fields beside unsafe originals, sentinel-only removal, or sanitizing only a few known fixture strings.

Rule: Preserve tool/provider/cancellation outcomes. Mark owning and propagating failures ERROR with a bounded, sanitized error.type; do not invent failed responses or usage. Use the current official inference-duration Histogram in seconds and token-usage Counter with correct dimensions and missing-usage semantics.
Example: Each process records two actual HTTP attempt durations and 11 input/7 output tokens from the successful response; missing usage is zero or unknown only where the convention requires it.
Evidence: Inspect actual error paths and measurements, and assess every other source-applicable metric.
Insufficient evidence: Fabricated billing, content/request IDs in metric dimensions, or a fake logger pipeline for business stdout.

Rule: Resolve the approved Project and scoped Agent Stream through SDK-free native HTTP. Validate returned identity/association, reuse them on a clean process start, and bind only the single trace export path. Preserve harmless headers and configuration precedence; keep metrics unbound.
Example: Creation returns 201. A real lookup 403 causes no speculative POST or stale routing; a real trace 400 stays a failed acceptance result. Business results and independent metric export continue in both failures.
Evidence: Use actual HTTP journals and current returned IDs/trace headers. Distinguish Studio projectid/logstreamid from public AO projectid/agentstreamid applicability.
Insufficient evidence: Repeated creation, an added AO SDK/Python process, fabricated routing IDs, or treating local acceptance as cloud proof.

Rule: Before editing, capture the real zero-signal baseline; keep it and raw after/failure/repeat receipts. Preserve fixture/probe/checker/SDK inputs and business output. A clean deployment must build, start, execute every business path and export natively without eval, .observe or .agents, retaining only declared app assets.
Example: A focused semantic/schema/error/graph check detects a missing required field in actual native protobuf.
Evidence: Record exact baseline, native, failure, repeat and clean-copy commands, provenance and scoped local results. Inspect source and decoded receipts.
Insufficient evidence: String searches presented as runtime proof, edited receipts/grades, a selected happy-path sample, or an unsupported full-cloud claim.
